D0.5 assessed the package as incremental below the field floor, with ceiling 5.8 < 7.4 and salvageable=false, while leaving the global binary certificate and dependent richer-support theorem unresolved in the declared graph. tldr: A calibrated triangular-array four-price model has a matched all-sample excess maximum-regret rate \(\min\{1,(nh^2)^{-1/2}\}\), an exact nuisance-profiled critical curve, certified finite decision programs and attaining original-record selectors. The model uses Higbee-style iid randomization and consistency, decreasing convex unit-Lipschitz demand, \(\mathcal A=\{0,1/4,1/2,1\}\), utility \((2+d)y\), and \(\Theta=[1/2,3/5]\times[0,7/20]\). The no-information value is explicit, and the sharp high-information Gaussian constant is proved. A global certificate establishes \(V_2(100)\le0.03456<0.0346<V(100)\): finite-information calibration can require nature priors with more than two states even though binary priors exhaust zero information and share the leading high-information constant.
